findings.title: Migration SQL injection and un-normalized hosts
findings.body: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb line 25 the migration builds SQL with string interpolation: VALUES ('#{h}', ...). A host containing a quote breaks the migration, and admin-controlled input is not quoted. It also inserts the raw old setting value without stripping scheme/path, while EmbeddableHost strips scheme/path on validation and host_allowed? compares only URI.host. Migrated rows like 'http://discourse.org' or 'https://example.com/1234' will never match, so previously allowed embeds become blocked. Quote values and normalize with the same stripping logic.

findings.title: Migration uses cmd_tuples for SELECT, skipping data
findings.body: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb line 19 the code checks embeddable_hosts.cmd_tuples > 0 to decide if old hosts exist. For a SELECT, PG returns cmd_tuples 0 and row count in ntuples/ntuples. The condition is false even when rows exist, so no hosts are migrated, then line 31 deletes site_settings embeddable_hosts/embed_category. This silently loses all configured hosts. Use ntuples/any?/empty? check.

findings.title: Migration crashes when settings missing
findings.body: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb line 9 the code does execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i assuming a row exists for embed_category join and line 15 assumes uncategorized_category_id exists. On fresh installs or when embed_category does not match a category name, [0] is nil and nil['id'] raises NoMethodError, failing the whole migration. Guard empty results and default safely.

findings.title: before_validation crashes on nil host
findings.body: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb line 6 before_validation calls self.host.sub! twice without a nil guard. If host is nil (blank form, missing param, direct create), this raises NoMethodError instead of a validation error, turning user error into 500 in Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#create/update. Guard with return if host blank and add presence validation.

findings.title: No uniqueness validation or index on host
findings.body: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb line 2 there is only format validation and no uniqueness validation, and the migration creates embeddable_hosts without a unique index. Admins can create duplicate host rows, making TopicEmbed.import category mapping ambiguous (record_for_host returns first) and host_allowed? nondeterministic. Add validates_uniqueness_of case-insensitive and a unique lower(host) index.

findings.title: Host lookup case-sensitive and port-mismatched
findings.body: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb line 17 record_for_host does where("lower(host) = ?", host) where host is URI.host as-is, not downcased, so an uppercase referer fails to match a stored lowercase host even though comparison lowercases only the column. Stored values may also include :port (validation allows it) while lookup compares only hostname without port, so hosts with ports never match. Downcase the input and normalize port handling consistently.

findings.title: Update/destroy crash on missing record instead of 404
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb line 10 update does EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first then save_host(host) without nil check, so unknown id calls methods on nil and 500s. Same pattern in destroy at line 15 where host.destroy on nil 500s. Return 404 for missing records.

findings.title: Plural embedded hydration crashes on null
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6 line 197 _hydrateEmbedded does obj[k].map for keys matching *_ids without checking for null. If the payload contains a null ids array, this throws TypeError and breaks store.find/findAll hydration. Guard for non-array values and filter unresolvable ids instead of inserting undefined.

findings.title: Edit loses category when hydration absent, save ignores server
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6 line 26 edit() reads host.category.id only. After store hydration, category_id is deleted and only category remains; if category failed to resolve, categoryId becomes undefined and saving overwrites the real category with blank (resetting to uncategorized). Line 38 then sets category from local Category.findById instead of the server response, so server-side defaulting to uncategorized is not reflected until reload. Fall back to category_id and apply server-returned values.

findings.title: No coverage for embeddable-hosts CRUD
findings.body: In spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb line 5 and the matching embedding_controller_spec, the only test is subclass-of-AdminController. There is no coverage for create/update/destroy auth, validation errors, missing-record 404s, category defaulting, or host normalization. Bugs in save_host nil handling and duplicate hosts can merge unnoticed. Add request specs for those paths.

findings.title: Exposes unimplemented embeddable_hosts routes
findings.body: In config/routes.rb line 153 resources :embeddable_hosts generates index/show/new/edit plus create/update/destroy, but Admin::EmbeddableHostsController only implements create/update/destroy. Extra routes 404 with ActionNotFound and widen the admin surface. Restrict to only: [:create, :update, :destroy].

findings.title: Admin check replaces only first underscore
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6 line 22 basePath does type.replace('_','-') which replaces only the first underscore. Types with multiple underscores will not match ADMIN_MODELS and will use '/' instead of '/admin/', causing 404s. Use a global replace.
